And User is on the Support dashbroad page
When User clicks on All Ticket in the sidebar menu
Then User should be on the All Ticket page
When User clicks on New Ticket button
And User selects "Siva Kumar" from thw Customer dropdown in the form
And User enters "Login issue" in the Subject field
And User enters "Unable to login to account" in the Description field
And User selects "gokul" from the Assignee dropdown in the form
And User selects "critical" from the Priority dropdown in the form
And User selects "complaint" from the Category dropdown in the form
And User selects "open" from the Status dropdown in the form
And User clicks on the Create Ticket button
Then Ticket created successfully message should be displayed
And The new ticket "Login issue" should be displayed in the ticket table
